# FunctionType type

The property decorator a decorator factory hands back.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type FunctionType = (...args: any[]) => any;
```

## Remarks

Loose on purpose: it stands for the decorator returned by [ColumnIndex](/api/pg-sequelize/latest/pg-sequelize.columnindex/) and [NullableIndex](/api/pg-sequelize/latest/pg-sequelize.nullableindex/) when either is called with options, whose exact parameter list differs between TypeScript's legacy and current decorator emit.
